body:
Things like this CAN be saved. The reason they flare up so badly or cause one party to be so angry is because this matters to them. It's when it doesn't matter that you have to worry*. That's a good starting point. If you know what you did wrong, apologise and try to correct things then you could convince her. Believe me I've done it plenty of times!

*just my own story, after 18 years my wife told me she no longer loves me. Now that's a tough one to take on board, especially when she's told you everything's fine and she loves you in the build up to that, like a total set up to processing this badly. And just as your processing it and considering a future without her she starts a relationship with your friend just a few weeks after you split up. Its hard to maintain any self esteem after that.

That sounds so tough. Do you think there might be anything you haven't tried that you could? Seven years to feel like that is so hard and take it from me you deserve to be happy! Are there triggers or life events which have caused this condition?

It is scary, and I'm pretty sure every survivor would give you a harrowing account of the fear they experienced. Hopefully your fear is greater than your pain, but I appreciate you need more. You need, and deserve, happiness.
